title: UneceCoordinateReferenceSystem
description:
A coordinate reference system that is used in a contextually local sense to describe the relative locations of objects
in which coordinates of points are recorded in a Coordinate System (CS) (reference ISO 19111).

identifier.description: The identifier for this CS engineering coordinate reference system.

level.description: The level, expressed as text, of this CS engineering coordinate reference system.

name.description: The name, expressed as text, for this CS engineering coordinate reference system.

specifiedDelimitedPeriod.description: A delimited period specified for this CS engineering coordinate reference system.

specifiedPeriod.description: A delimited period specified for this CS engineering coordinate reference system.

subordinateCoordinateReferenceSystem.description: A CS engineering coordinate reference system subordinate to this CS engineering coordinate reference system.
